parameters.content:
USER-STACK VERSION — same source method with the user's practical stack.
Source: https://www.instagram.com/raycfu/reel/DYWFQKAPgmF/
Enhancement: NEXEN local content queue, source/claim ledger, scene-level validation, original-media rights checklist and FFmpeg/Whisper stage handoff. Whisper package was absent in the checked Python environment; no render is claimed.

Operational state: this is a proposed architecture. Required external credentials, models, worker or API are called out in the pair comparison and README. Nothing is activated by import.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-5', max_tokens: 2500, system: 'You write faceless YouTube scripts. Reply ONLY with JSON: {"hook":"pattern-interrupt hook, deliverable in the first 30 seconds","open_loops":["..."],"scenes":[{"spoken":"spoken-English narration, not essay English","visual_text":"on-screen text","pause_markers":"[pause] positions"}],"soft_cta":"...","titles":["3 options"],"description":"...","tags":["..."],"chapters":[{"time":"00:00","label":"..."}]}. Requirements: hook is a pattern interrupt; use open loops; spoken English; include pause markers and visual_text for every scene; end with a soft CTA.', messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'Niche: ' + $json.niche + '
Topic: ' + $json.topic + '
Audience: ' + ($json.audience||'') + '
Target length (min): ' + $json.target_length_min } ] }) }}
